description: Source code for SparkConnectConfigHandler class in Apache Spark, handling configuration requests via gRPC.

classes.name: SparkConnectConfigHandler
classes.description: Handles configuration requests for Spark Connect via gRPC, including get/set/unset operations and warnings.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming configuration requests and dispatches to specific handlers based on operation type.

methods.name: doHandle
methods.description: Executes the specific configuration operation within a session context and sends response.

methods.name: handleSet
methods.description: Handles setting configuration key-value pairs, with optional silent failure warnings.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for specified keys.

methods.name: handleGetWithDefault
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values with default fallback.

methods.name: handleGetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all configuration key-value pairs, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: handleIsModifiable
methods.description: Checks if configuration keys are modifiable.

methods.name: getWarning
methods.description: Returns warning message if configuration key is unsupported or deprecated.
